The primary security issue identified in the text is the failure to clearly define security responsibilities within the shared security model of the cloud service. In a shared security model, the cloud provider and the customer have distinct responsibilities; for example, the provider typically secures the infrastructure, while the customer is responsible for securing their data, access controls, and configurations. By not clearly defining these roles for their internal IT team, the company risks creating security gaps where neither party assumes responsibility for critical security tasks, leading to potential vulnerabilities in data storage and access.
